stories.title: Who Is Alice Huang, the Woman in the Middle of Nvidia’s Spy Scandal?
stories.summary: Alice Huang, identified by U.S. intelligence as a Chinese asset, transitioned from Shanghai finance to collaborate with major tech companies. Her work involved acquiring crucial A.I. chips, placing her at the center of a spy scandal involving Nvidia.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Giant IPO Will Tie It Closer to Nvidia
stories.summary: Nvidia intends to invest $10 billion in Anthropic as part of the A.I. company's initial public offering. This investment is the largest among several new financial commitments from major companies to Anthropic, further linking it to Nvidia.

stories.title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar says that the ChatGPT-maker will keep investing in AI data centers; what will chan
stories.summary: OpenAI's CFO, Sarah Friar, stated that the company will continue to invest in AI data centers.

stories.title: Meta, Google Don't Want To Pay Publishers: How Indonesia's AI Copyright Plan Is Putting Big Tech On Edge
stories.summary: Indonesia is considering changes to its copyright law that could mandate tech companies like Meta, Google, and TikTok to pay publishers for using their content. This potential amendment is causing concern among major tech firms.

stories.title: AI, Payments And A Major App Makeover; WhatsApp CEO Kunal Shah Reveals What's Coming Next
stories.summary: WhatsApp plans to expand its services beyond messaging by improving communication features, streamlining daily tasks, and incorporating artificial intelligence. The CEO, Kunal Shah, revealed these upcoming changes for the app.

stories.title: Nvidia Hires Wachtell Lipton to Investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s Affair With Chinese Executive
stories.summary: Nvidia has hired the law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate its CEO, Jensen Huang, regarding an alleged affair with a Chinese executive. A former acting U.S. attorney is leading this inquiry into the chip maker's chief executive.

stories.title: Anthropic’s I.P.O. and the Clubby Business of A.I.
stories.summary: Some of the largest investors in Anthropic's upcoming initial public offering are also key business partners of the artificial intelligence company. This situation highlights the close relationships within the AI industry.

stories.title: The Fed Has to Raise Rates. How Fast to Go Has Officials Divided.
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve is facing a challenge to its measured approach to raising interest rates due to increasing price pressures. Officials are divided on how quickly to proceed with rate hikes.

stories.title: Sensex has rallied nearly 12%: Is it time to relook at your investment strategy?
stories.summary: The Sensex has seen a significant rally of nearly 12% since late October, accompanied by upgrades from global brokerages for Indian equities. This shift in market sentiment prompts a reevaluation of investment strategies and a focus on specific sectors.

stories.title: Moody's Upgrades India's FY27 GDP Growth Forecast To 7%; Here's Why
stories.summary: Moody's has increased India's GDP growth forecast for fiscal year 2027 to 7 percent. This upgrade is attributed to strong consumption, a recovery in investment, and the country's ability to withstand global energy shocks.

stories.title: Republicans Turn Back Effort to Impeach Hegseth
stories.summary: Republicans united to stop the impeachment process against the defense secretary. This action prevented him from facing a significant reprimand and possible removal from his position.

stories.title: Sonia Gandhi's Memoir Sparks Debate on 1984 and 2002 Riots
stories.summary: Sonia Gandhi's memoir has initiated discussions regarding the 1984 and 2002 riots.

stories.title: Stung by Losses, G.O.P. Chooses Jordan and Thune as Leaders
stories.summary: Following significant election losses, the Republican party selected new leaders. In the House, Republicans opted for new leadership, while in the Senate, they re-elected their current leader.

stories.title: What Trump Said in His Letter to Biden in 2021
stories.summary: Former President Trump's letter to President Biden in 2021, as revealed in a new book, is notable for its friendly tone. This tone contrasts sharply with Trump's public statements about his successor.

stories.title: Kulgam Terror Attack Caught On Cam: 3 CRPF Jawans Injured, Political War On | Breaking Ground
stories.summary: A terror attack in Kulgam was captured on camera, resulting in injuries to three CRPF jawans. This incident has also sparked a political conflict.

stories.title: IBM to end H-1B, green card sponsorship for roles in biggest unit after Trump administration's crackdown | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: IBM will no longer sponsor H-1B visas or green cards for positions within its largest division. This decision follows increased restrictions on immigration by the Trump administration.

stories.title: Trump Administration's Plan to End H-1B Grace Period Draws More Than 31,000 Public Comments
stories.summary: The Trump administration's proposal to eliminate the H-1B grace period has generated over 31,000 public comments. This indicates significant public interest and concern regarding the proposed change.

stories.title: Colleges Say OPT Fee Would Cost Tens of Millions
stories.summary: A proposed fee for colleges would require them to pay a substantial amount for each international graduate to work temporarily in the U.S. after graduation. Colleges argue they cannot afford this cost and believe passing it to students would create an unfair system.

stories.title: Students, top Yale lawyer urge ICE to scrap fee for foreign student jobs
stories.summary: Students and a leading Yale lawyer are urging ICE to withdraw a proposed fee for foreign students seeking employment. This fee would impact international students' ability to work after graduation.

stories.title: Interest in US surges as study destination up 40% after midterms
stories.summary: Interest in the United States as a study destination has increased significantly, rising by 40% since the recent midterm elections. This suggests a renewed appeal for international students to pursue education in the U.S.
